run_route_guide_server: run the gRPC route guide server on port 50051 with a thread pool of 10 workers
build_GetFeature: build a gRPC unary call to look up a feature at a given point location
build_ListFeatures: build a gRPC server streaming call to list all features within a rectangular bounding box
build_RecordRoute: build a gRPC client streaming call to record a route and get point count, distance, and elapsed time summary
build_RouteChat: build a gRPC bidirectional streaming call to chat and receive notes at matching locations
